---
title: "GitHub and Netlify"
subtitle: "Publish the report without publishing private input data"
---

## GitHub repository

1. Create the project repository from the instructor's OMIS 681 template if your assignment requires it.
2. Open this folder through `QSR_Stage1_Project.Rproj` in RStudio.
3. Confirm `data/*.csv` is ignored by Git before your first commit.
4. Invite `biagiopalese` as a collaborator if the class template instructions require it.
5. Commit your source files and rendered `_site/` after rendering; never commit the raw assigned CSVs.

## Netlify

Import the GitHub repository into Netlify. This project includes `netlify.toml` with the `_site` folder as the publish directory. Render the site locally and commit `_site/` before publishing. Check the live site on desktop and mobile.

## End-of-session routine

```bash
quarto render
git status
git add -A
git commit -m "update QSR analysis"
git push
```

Before committing, review `git status --short` to ensure no raw CSV files are staged. The `.gitignore` in this project ignores the assigned data files by name and extension.

## Scope and transparency

The report describes patterns in the selected restaurant's data. Promotion, weather, events, and marketing comparisons are observational. They do not establish causation. The margin metric is an estimated price-minus-food-cost measure, not net profit.
